description: This file defines the ChainedBlockStream class used for reading data streams from OLE container files, implementing PHP stream wrapper functionality, including methods for opening, reading, seeking, and closing streams.

classes.name: ChainedBlockStream
classes.description: A PHP stream wrapper class for reading blocks of data from an OLE container, supporting stream operations like open, read, seek, and close.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Initializes the stream for reading, parsing the resource URI, retrieving the corresponding OLE instance, and loading the data blocks based on the block ID.

methods.name: stream_close
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the stream is closed.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream up to the specified count.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position within the stream, supporting SEEK_SET, SEEK_CUR, and SEEK_END.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns metadata about the stream, currently only size information.
